connector.name: Dokploy MCP
connector.registryDescription: Dokploy MCP server for Codex, Cursor, and Claude with compact stdio and hosted HTTP modes
connector.summary: Hosted at {remotehost}{mcppath} over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package dokploy-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vcode-sh account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-Dokploy-Url
headers.description: Dokploy panel URL for this request. Accepts the panel URL, /api, or /api/trpc and is normalized automatically.

headers.name: X-Dokploy-Api-Key
headers.description: Dokploy API key from Settings > Profile > API/CLI.

env.name: DOKPLOY_URL
env.description: Optional when local Dokploy credentials already exist. Otherwise provide the Dokploy panel URL.

env.name: DOKPLOY_API_KEY
env.description: Optional when local Dokploy credentials already exist. Otherwise provide the Dokploy API key.

env.name: DOKPLOY_PROFILES_JSON
env.description: Optional JSON object of named Dokploy targets. Use this when you want explicit named profiles in addition to the local default target.
